title: Otis stays home; the band's private train car to San Francisco
summary: Otis White declines the USO trip because of a girl; the band travels west in a private car with a drawing room and plays all night.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: How come Skins didn't make it? How come Otis didn't make it?
Otis didn't want to go. Otis had just gotten married. Otis had -- either he had just gotten married or he was going with this girl.
Otis didn't want to -- he didn't want to leave her.

That's what happened. Otis went on back to St. Louis. So we got on this train, and we had fun, Jean and I -- the band had a whole private car. And I had one drawing room, and Jeannie had the other drawing room. And we had a ballroom going down there. We'd play all night, man, we'd blow. Then we'd go back to the dining room and eat and all that. It was a lot of fun.
